protocol: Three alternating whole/four-part ThinLTO pairs of the repository particles versus benchmark. One million particles, one thread, 20 warm-up and 300 measured ticks. Ordinary desktop load, no quiet-machine gate. Compare medians of process tick medians; this is a runtime sanity check, not a general speed guarantee.
